+ # Data-Layer Workspace: Product Requirements Document
+ 
+ &lt;context&gt;
+ # Overview  
+ The **Data-Layer Workspace** is a shared package that offers a single, reusable and extensible access layer to all data providers used throughout the **Ultraterrestrial-Resurrection** monorepo. It solves the problem of duplicated client instantiation, scattered credential handling and inconsistent helper utilities by providing:
+ 
+ * **Singleton clients** for each provider in both **TypeScript** and **Python** runtimes.
+ * Centralised configuration management with environment variable support.
+ * A plug-in architecture that allows new providers (e.g. Supabase, Convex) to be added with minimal effort.
+ * Full backward compatibility for existing consumers such as &#96;apps/app&#96;, &#96;apps/cli&#96; and &#96;apps/disclosure-rag&#96;.
+ 
+ The primary stakeholders are backend and full-stack developers working in this monorepo who need reliable, type-safe and consistent data access without duplicating boilerplate.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # Core Features  
+ 1. **Shared Xata Provider**  
+    * &#96;getXataClient(opts?) → XataClient&#96; (TS) and &#96;get_xata_client(**kwargs) -&gt; XataClient&#96; (Py) return singleton, typed clients.  
+    * Generated schema typings live at &#96;src/xata/codegen&#96; and are committed to VCS.  
+    * Legacy helper functions (e.g. &#96;getEvents&#96;) are re-exported from the same barrel file.
+ 
+ 2. **Firecrawl Provider (Node &amp; Python)**  
+    * &#96;getFirecrawlClient(opts?)&#96; (TS) and &#96;get_firecrawl_client(api_key=None, **kwargs)&#96; (Py) wrap the official SDKs and guarantee singleton behaviour.  
+    * Existing helper utilities (search, scrape, crawl, …) are re-exported unchanged.
+ 
+ 3. **Provider Registry &amp; Extensibility**  
+    * &#96;PROVIDERS&#96; registry exposes each provider via a strongly-typed map.  
+    * Adding a new provider requires only a single helper module (&#96;src/&lt;provider&gt;/index.(ts|py)&#96;) and one export in the registry.
+ 
+ 4. **Configuration Management**  
+    * Reads credentials from environment variables or &#96;.env&#96; files; throws descriptive errors if missing.  
+    * Ships a &#96;.env.example&#96; with all required keys (&#96;XATA_DATABASE_URL&#96;, &#96;XATA_API_KEY&#96;, &#96;FIRECRAWL_API_KEY&#96;).
+ 
+ 5. **Testing &amp; Quality Gates**  
+    * Jest tests ensure singleton behaviour in TS; PyTest mirrors this in Python (skipped if keys are absent).  
+    * A lint rule forbids instantiating new provider clients outside the workspace.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # User Experience  
+ **Personas**  
+ * *Package Consumer* – Developer working in an app within the monorepo who imports &#96;@ultra/data-layer&#96; to obtain clients &amp; helpers.  
+ * *Package Maintainer* – Contributor responsible for adding new data providers or updating existing ones.
+ 
+ **Key Flows**  
+ 1. Consumer imports and calls &#96;getXataClient()&#96; → receives a singleton client with zero manual configuration.  
+ 2. Maintainer adds a new provider: scaffold helper → add to registry → update tests.
+ 
+ **UI/UX Considerations**  
+ Although primarily a backend package, developer-experience is paramount: clear TypeScript typings, helpful error messages and comprehensive README docs.
+ 
+ &lt;/context&gt;
+ 
+ &lt;PRD&gt;
+ # Technical Architecture  
+ ## System Components
+ * **TypeScript Workspace** (&#96;packages/data-layer/src&#96;) – Registry, provider helpers, generated typings.  
+ * **Python Workspace** (&#96;packages/data-layer/python&#96;) – Mirror registry and helpers for Python runtimes.  
+ * **Code-Gen Script** (&#96;packages/data-layer/scripts/codegen.ts&#96;) – Runs &#96;xata codegen&#96; and commits artefacts.
+ 
+ ## Data Models
+ No direct data models are defined; the workspace relies on provider-specific schemas (e.g. Xata generated typings).
+ 
+ ## APIs &amp; Integrations
+ * **Xata TS &amp; Python SDKs** – Primary database access.  
+ * **Firecrawl SDKs** – Web scraping and crawling utilities.  
+ * Future integrations (Supabase, Convex, …) plug into the same registry pattern.
+ 
+ ## Infrastructure Requirements
+ * Node ≥ 18 or Bun ≥ 1.0 for JavaScript/TypeScript consumers.  
+ * Python ≥ 3.8 (compatible with **uv**) for Python consumers.  
+ * Environment variables for credentials.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # Development Roadmap  
+ | Phase | Scope | Deliverables |
+ |-------|-------|--------------|
+ | **MVP (v1.0)** | Scaffold workspace, implement Xata &amp; Firecrawl providers, registry, env handling, code-gen script | • Working singleton helpers  
+ • Jest &amp; PyTest suites  
+ • &#96;.env.example&#96;  
+ • Documentation |
+ | **v1.1** | Plug-in architecture polish, lint rule to prevent external instantiation | • ESLint custom rule  
+ • Example stub for Supabase |
+ | **v1.2** | CI/CD &amp; Release Automation | • GitHub Actions for code-gen &amp; publishing  
+ • Automated semantic versioning |
+ | **Future** | Browser / Edge runtime variants, additional providers | • Edge-compatible bundles  
+ • Convex provider example |
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # Logical Dependency Chain  
+ 1. **Scaffold Workspace &amp; Copy Existing Helpers**  
+ 2. **Run Codegen &amp; Commit Typings**  
+ 3. **Implement Singleton Helpers &amp; Registry**  
+ 4. **Refactor Existing Apps to Use New Package**  
+ 5. **Add Tests &amp; Lint Rules**  
+ 6. **CI/CD Automation &amp; Future Provider Stubs**
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # Risks and Mitigations  
+ | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
+ |------|--------|-----------|
+ | Missing or invalid credentials | Providers fail at runtime | Early runtime check with descriptive errors &amp; &#96;.env.example&#96; |
+ | Multiple client instantiations | Memory leaks &amp; connection thrashing | Lint rule + Jest/PyTest to enforce singleton |
+ | Backward-compatibility breakage | Downstream apps fail to compile | Maintain identical helper APIs &amp; automated integration tests |
+ | CI/CD complexity | Delayed releases | Incremental adoption; start with manual release before automating |
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ # Appendix  
+ * **References**  
+   * Xata TS SDK – npm &#96;@xata.io/client&#96;  
+   * Xata Python SDK – PyPI &#96;xata&#96;  
+   * Firecrawl Node SDK – &lt;https://docs.firecrawl.dev/sdks/node&gt;  
+   * Firecrawl Python SDK – &lt;https://docs/firecrawl.dev/sdks/python&gt;  
+   * **uv** – ultra-fast Python package manager – &lt;https://pypi.org/project/uv/&gt;
+ 
+ &lt;/PRD&gt;
